summary: Signature PDF is a self-hosted document management tool designed for handling portable document format files. It provides features for applying digital signatures, editing metadata, compressing file sizes, organising pages, and collaborating on documents.
goodFor: It suits teams or individuals needing a private, self-hosted workspace to sign, compress, and organise document collections without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The project exhibits slowing maintenance activity, which may result in delayed security patches or bug fixes. It also competes in a crowded ecosystem with more mature alternatives.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker or standard deb packages, typically requiring persistent storage volumes for uploaded documents and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
